description: This file defines an interface protocol for car data repositories, specifying method signatures for listing cars with filters and retrieving cars by ID. It serves as an abstraction layer to allow swapping data sources without changing endpoint logic.

classes.name: CarRepository
classes.description: Protocol defining the interface for car data repositories, including methods for listing cars with filters and retrieving a car by ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] list_cars( self, *, q: Optional[str] = None, make: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, year_min: Optional[int] = None, year_max: Optional[int] = None, price_min: Optional[float] = None, price_max: Optional[float] = None, sort: Optional[str] = "-year", page: int = 1, page_size: int = 12, )
methods.description: Returns a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of cars encapsulated in a standard envelope dictionary.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_car_by_id(self, car_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a single car by its ID, returning None if not found.

ctags.name: get_car_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_car_by_id(self, car_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: list_cars
ctags.signature: ( self, *, q: Optional[str] = None, make: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, year_min: Optional[int] = None, year_max: Optional[int] = None, price_min: Optional[float] = None, price_max: Optional[float] = None, sort: Optional[str] = "-year", page: int = 1, page_size: int = 12, )
